english.title: Carry / remove / deposit / harbour / keep / conceal / deal with Class B drug with intent evade prohibition on importing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was knowingly concerned in carrying, removing, depositing, harbouring, keeping, concealing or dealing with certain goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CLASS 'B' DRUG AND INCLUDE QUANTITY..), a Class B drug, with respect to the importation of which a prohibition was for the time being in force and did so with intent to evade the prohibition imposed by section 3(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section 170(1)(b), (3) and (4) of, and Schedule 1 to, the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording should be used in connection with a prohibition/restriction on the importing of a Class 'B' drug by virtue of section 3 of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.
(ii) See section 171 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 for general provisions as to offences and penalties.
(iii) See section 49 of that Act for forfeiture provisions
